ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast between large contiguous white high-intensity regions (approx. 80-85% of visible surface) and low-intensity black pigmentation along the trailing edge and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central field; thick, continuous black banding along the entire trailing edge; small, isolated low-intensity pixel clusters (mottling) visible on the medial and distal surfaces of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression dividing the lobes with a sharp interior convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular peaks and valleys detected along the entire trailing edge boundary, with particularly jagged, non-uniform serrations on the medial section of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical sweep; the left lobe follows a standard convex curve toward a broad tip, while the right lobe displays a more acute upward trajectory toward a narrow, pointed tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark pixel clusters detected at the distal extremity of the left lobe and scattered along the medial-distal transition of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, brownish diagonal linear pixel disruptions observed on the lower central region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular pixel loss/jaggedness at the tip of the right lobe; distinct vertical low-intensity pigmentation stroke originating near the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in the distribution and amplitude of trailing edge serrations between the left and right lobes.
